title: 锈鞘归人
logline: 大漠边关客栈夜，归隐老镖头与掌柜秋娘的简淡对话，道尽江湖人归途的苍凉与释然

shots.narrationZh: 大漠风沙卷暮云，远驼铃漫夜来
shots.narrationEn: Desert sandstorms roll across twilight clouds, distant camel bells echo through the night
shots.visual: Moonlit desert night, undulating sand dunes outside the frontier inn, a slow-moving camel caravan with tinkling bells in the far distance
shots.ttsDirection: 苍凉悠远，语速舒缓，『卷』『漫』重读，气息沉稳如风掠沙丘

shots.visual: Inside the earthen-walled frontier inn, grey-bearded Qin Wubian in a worn dark grey robe sits in the shadowy corner, a rusty-sheathed long knife hangs at his waist, he drinks alone from a rough ceramic cup under the dim flickering oil lamp

lines.zh: 这是老秦最后一趟走镖，刀早锈在鞘里了
lines.en: This is old Qin's last escort trip, my blade has long rusted in its sheath

shots.ttsDirection: 落寞疲惫，语速缓沉，气息滞重，尾音微颤如饮闷酒

shots.visual: Qiu Niang, the 48-year-old innkeeper in indigo cloth and dark apron with a wooden hairpin in her bun, stands at the counter wiping rough ceramic bowls, her hands moving constantly

lines.zh: 刀锈了，人才睡得踏实，我给你温酒去
lines.en: A rusty blade lets a man sleep sound, I'll warm some wine for you

shots.ttsDirection: 平和温淡，语速平稳，气息沉静，带安抚暖意

shots.visual: Qiu Niang places a warmed ceramic wine jar on the rough wooden table in front of Qin Wubian, the faint oil lamp light glinting off the rusty knife sheath at his waist

lines.en: If the blade rusts, the man should rest

shots.ttsDirection: 关切温软，语速稍缓，气息轻缓，带暖意

shots.narrationZh: 刀锈了，人便该歇，好刀待归人
shots.narrationEn: A rusted blade means it's time to rest, a fine blade waits for its returning owner
shots.visual: Close-up of the rusty-sheathed long knife resting on the wooden table, soft moonlight streams through the inn door onto the sheath, the quiet desert night is visible outside the doorway
shots.ttsDirection: 苍凉释然，语速放缓，『锈』『歇』『归人』重读，气息悠长如轻叹
